<a id="symbol-HttpUrl"></a>
## `HttpUrl` · immutable record · [source](urls.aug#L10)

Absolute HTTP(S) URL in August's ASCII DNS-host profile; preserve the original spelling.

It takes `text` as a string, kept read-only (1 to 8192 bytes. Hosts use 1 to 253 bytes, labels of 1 to 63 letters/digits/hyphens and at least one letter.
Optional ports are 1 to 65535. Path/query use RFC 3986 characters and checked percent triplets).

Construction can fail with `ConversionError`.

<a id="symbol-HttpUrl.initialize"></a>
### `HttpUrl.initialize` · [source](urls.aug#L10)

It calls [`_validateHttpUrl`](urls.aug.md#symbol-_validateHttpUrl) with `text`. [source](urls.aug#L12)

<a id="symbol-parseHttpUrl"></a>
## `parseHttpUrl` · [source](urls.aug#L17)

Parse the same ASCII HTTP(S)/DNS profile as HttpUrl, preserving case, escapes and an empty query. It takes `text` as a string. Failures can raise `ConversionError` (Invalid or unsupported URL syntax). It returns a [`HttpUrl`](urls.aug.md#symbol-HttpUrl) with `text`. [source](urls.aug#L18)

</details>

<a id="symbol-_validateHttpUrl"></a>
## `_validateHttpUrl` · [source](urls.aug#L24)

It is private to its defining scope. It takes `text` as a string. Failures can raise `ConversionError`.

It checks that `text.byteLength` is at least `8` and `text.byteLength` is at most `8192`. It raises a `ConversionError` at the first failed check. It sets `bytes` to the UTF-8 bytes of `text`. It sets `start` to `7`. [source](urls.aug#L25-L28)

It sets `scheme` to [`asciiLower`](ascii.aug.md#symbol-asciiLower) with `text` from [`asciiSlice`](ascii.aug.md#symbol-asciiSlice) with `input` from `bytes`, `start` `0`, and `end` `7`. If `scheme` does not equal `"http://"`, it checks that `text.byteLength` is at least `9` and [`asciiLower`](ascii.aug.md#symbol-asciiLower) with `text` from [`asciiSlice`](ascii.aug.md#symbol-asciiSlice) with `input` from `bytes`, `start` `0`, and `end` `8` equals `"https://"`. It raises a `ConversionError` at the first failed check. It sets `start` to `8`. [source](urls.aug#L29-L33)

After that conditional work, it sets `end` to `start`. While `end` is less than `text.byteLength`, it sets `character` to [`asciiAt`](ascii.aug.md#symbol-asciiAt) with `input` from `bytes` and `index` from `end`. If `character` equals `"/"` or `character` equals `"?"`, it leaves the nearest loop after cleanup. It increases `end` by `1`. [source](urls.aug#L34-L39)

After the loop, it sets `authority` to [`asciiSlice`](ascii.aug.md#symbol-asciiSlice) with `input` from `bytes`, `start`, and `end`. It calls [`_validateAuthority`](urls.aug.md#symbol-_validateAuthority) with `authority`. It sets `index` to `end`. While `index` is less than `text.byteLength`, it sets `character` to [`asciiAt`](ascii.aug.md#symbol-asciiAt) with `input` from `bytes` and `index`. [source](urls.aug#L40-L57)

If `character` equals `"?"`, it continues without an operation. Otherwise, if `character` equals `"%"`, it checks that (`index` plus `2`) is less than `text.byteLength` and [`_hex`](urls.aug.md#symbol-_hex) with `character` from [`asciiAt`](ascii.aug.md#symbol-asciiAt) with `input` from `bytes` and `index` from `index` plus `1` returns true and [`_hex`](urls.aug.md#symbol-_hex) with `character` from [`asciiAt`](ascii.aug.md#symbol-asciiAt) with `input` from `bytes` and `index` from `index` plus `2` returns true. It raises a `ConversionError` at the first failed check. It increases `index` by `2`. [source](urls.aug#L45-L56)

Otherwise, it checks that [`_pathCharacter`](urls.aug.md#symbol-_pathCharacter) with `character` returns true or `character` equals `"/"`. It raises a `ConversionError` at the first failed check. After that conditional work, it increases `index` by `1`. [source](urls.aug#L55-L57)

<details>
<summary>Checked interface</summary>

```text
_validateHttpUrl(string text) returns void unless ConversionError
```

It takes `text` as a string. Failures can raise `ConversionError`.

</details>

<a id="symbol-_validateAuthority"></a>
## `_validateAuthority` · [source](urls.aug#L59)

It is private to its defining scope. It takes `authority` as a string. Failures can raise `ConversionError`.

It sets `parts` to `authority.split` with `separator` `":"`. It checks that the number of elements in `parts` is at most `2`. It raises a `ConversionError` at the first failed check. It sets `host` to the item at index `0` in `parts`. [source](urls.aug#L60-L91)

It checks that `host.byteLength` does not equal `0` and `host.byteLength` is at most `253`. It raises a `ConversionError` at the first failed check. It sets `hasLetter` to `false`. [source](urls.aug#L65-L67)

For each `label` in a snapshot of `host.split` with `separator` `"."`, it checks that `label.byteLength` does not equal `0` and `label.byteLength` is at most `63`. It raises a `ConversionError` at the first failed check. It sets `bytes` to the UTF-8 bytes of `label`. It sets `index` to `0`. [source](urls.aug#L68-L80)

While `index` is less than `label.byteLength`, it sets `character` to [`asciiAt`](ascii.aug.md#symbol-asciiAt) with `input` from `bytes` and `index`. It sets `letter` to [`asciiLetter`](ascii.aug.md#symbol-asciiLetter) with `character`. It sets `alphanumeric` to `letter` or `character.isDecimal`. [source](urls.aug#L73-L80)

It checks that `alphanumeric` is true or (`character` equals `"-"` and `index` does not equal `0` and `index` does not equal (`label.byteLength` minus `1`)). It raises a `ConversionError` at the first failed check. It sets `hasLetter` to `hasLetter` or `letter`. It increases `index` by `1`. [source](urls.aug#L77-L80)

After the loop, it checks that `hasLetter` is true. It raises a `ConversionError` at the first failed check. If the number of elements in `parts` equals `2`, it sets `port` to the item at index `1` in `parts`. [source](urls.aug#L81-L89)

It checks that `port.isDecimal` returns true and `port.byteLength` is at most `5`. It raises a `ConversionError` at the first failed check. It sets `number` to `port.parseInteger`. [source](urls.aug#L85-L87)

It checks that `number` is at least `1` and `number` is at most `65535`. It raises a `ConversionError` at the first failed check. If this work raises `IndexError`, it raises a `ConversionError`. [source](urls.aug#L88-L91)

<details>
<summary>Checked interface</summary>

```text
_validateAuthority(string authority) returns void unless ConversionError
```

It takes `authority` as a string. Failures can raise `ConversionError`.

</details>

## `_pathCharacter` · [source](urls.aug#L93)

It is private to its defining scope. It takes `character` as a string. It returns `character.isToken` with `min` `1` and `max` `1` or `character` equals `":"` or `character` equals `"@"` or `character` equals `"!"` or `character` equals `"$"` or `character` equals `"&"` or `character` equals `"'"` or `character` equals `"("` or `character` equals `")"` or `character` equals `"*"` or `character` equals `"+"` or `character` equals `","` or `character` equals `";"` or `character` equals `"="`. <a id="symbol-_hex"></a>
## `_hex` · [source](urls.aug#L111)

It is private to its defining scope. It takes `character` as a string. It returns `character.isDecimal` or (`character.compare` with `other` `"A"` is at least `0` and `character.compare` with `other` `"F"` is at most `0`) or (`character.compare` with `other` `"a"` is at least `0` and `character.compare` with `other` `"f"` is at most `0`). [source](urls.aug#L112-L116)

<details>
<summary>Checked interface</summary>

```text
_hex(string character) returns bool
```

It takes `character` as a string.

</details>

## Dependencies

It uses [`asciiAt`](ascii.aug.md#symbol-asciiAt), [`asciiLetter`](ascii.aug.md#symbol-asciiLetter), [`asciiLower`](ascii.aug.md#symbol-asciiLower), and [`asciiSlice`](ascii.aug.md#symbol-asciiSlice) from `ascii`.

Built-in operations follow the [language reference](https://greenpandastudios.github.io/augscript/language-constructs).
